# Oklahoma Sports & Fitness Magazine

> A comprehensive resource for Oklahoma's running, triathlon, and endurance sports communities featuring event calendars, race results, training tools, and healthy lifestyle content.

Oklahoma Sports & Fitness Magazine serves as the primary hub for active lifestyle enthusiasts across Oklahoma and Tulsa, offering race calendars, results databases, training resources, and community connections. The publication is led by publisher Sean Call and covers endurance sports, outdoor events, and fitness-focused content for regional athletes.

## Key Topics

- Oklahoma running
- Triathlon events
- Endurance sports
- Race calendar
- Race results
- Training tips
- Healthy lifestyle
- Tulsa sports
- Running clubs

- Sean Call
- Magazine subscription
